title: Smart Data Models - RealEstateCore - Collection
description: An administrative grouping of entities that are addressed and treated as a unit for some purpose (rec:Collection, RealEstateCore 4.1). The specific collection (Apartment, Campus, Portfolio, Premises, RealEstate, EquipmentCollection, FurnitureCollection) is carried in recClass. Brick collection classes that REC places under Collection are covered by the brick-schema candidate's Collection model.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Collection'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Human-readable name (REC 'name' in DTDL, rdfs:label in the SHACL source).

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. A description of this item. Not a REC term.

identifiers.description: Property. Map of external identifiers for this entity, keyed by the namespace/system that issued them (REC 'identifiers', DTDL Map<string,string>).

customTags.description: Property. Map of free-form boolean tags (REC 'customTags', DTDL Map<string,boolean>).

customProperties.description: Property. Namespaced extension properties: a map from namespace to a map of property name to string value (REC 'customProperties', DTDL Map<string,Map<string,string>>).

recClass.description: Relationship. The specific RealEstateCore class of this entity (rdf:type), as the class IRI. REC 4.1 declares 8 non-deprecated classes in the rec:Collection hierarchy (this class and all its subclasses), all allowed here: Apartment; Campus; Collection; EquipmentCollection; FurnitureCollection; Portfolio; Premises; RealEstate.

includes.description: Relationship. Members of this collection (rec:includes). REC constrains the target per subclass: Apartment includes Rooms; Campus, Premises and RealEstate include Architecture (Site/Building/Level/Room/Zone); EquipmentCollection includes Equipment; FurnitureCollection includes Furniture; Portfolio includes anything.

documentation.description: Relationship. Documents describing this entity (rec:Document, e.g. manuals, drawings, contracts), as URIs.
